_comment: Pinned miner releases per platform. SHA256 hashes lock downloads against silent upstream tampering. Update both 'version' and 'sha256' together — the runtime downloader refuses to extract on mismatch. xmrig hashes come from the official SHA256SUMS file in the same release; the others are computed locally after download.
_note_2026_08_28: rigel dropped (binary-bundling-plan T2) — no advertised GPU algo was rigel-exclusive. Bundled+shipped miners are now xmrig/lolMiner/SRBMiner-MULTI only.
_note_2026_09_18: lolMiner dropped: RVN/CFX/ERG retired from mining; CFX (Octopus) was its only algorithm. Shipped miners are now xmrig and SRBMiner-MULTI only.
